name: Banyan Tree Phuket
short_description: A 5-star all-pool-villa resort in Cherngtalay with 218 Thai-inspired villas set around a lagoon near Bang Tao Beach.
ai_summary: Banyan Tree Phuket sits in Cherngtalay, in Phuket's Talang district, built around a lagoon near Bang Tao Beach. The resort's own Accor listing describes it as a tropical all-pool-villa resort with 218 villas, each designed in traditional Thai architectural style with modern amenities. No aggregate ALL guest rating was shown on the hotel's page at the time of research.

core_facts.address: 33/27 Moo Srisoonthorn Rd, Cherngtalay Amphur Talang, 83110 Phuket, Thailand

faqs.question: How many villas does Banyan Tree Phuket have?
faqs.answer: 218 villas, each with a private pool, inspired by traditional Thai architecture and set within a lagoon-side resort near Bang Tao Beach in Phuket's Cherngtalay district. The property is one of Banyan Tree's flagship all-pool-villa resorts in Southeast Asia, though its own Accor listing did not display an aggregate guest rating at the time of research.
